decision.observation: 10 mph, gear 1, timer 59:59.000, dots pale. The car is back on the gravel, well centred, facing up-frame where the road runs straight then bends gently left past white-marker posts and an avenue of birches/autumn trees on the right. A '+5s' marker sits beside the timer.
decision.hypothesis: The long W+D beat recovered from grass to centred gravel for only a 2 mph net gain (8 -> 10), confirming it as the right off-road tool. Now centred with a clear straight ahead, plain throttle is the cheapest way to build speed; the gentle left bend will drift the car right toward the birch verge, so steering can wait.
decision.memory: Long W+D from grass at 8 mph landed the car centred on gravel at 10 mph — reliable off-road-to-road recovery. Marker posts and birches/autumn trees line this stretch beyond the SPEEDART banners.
